summary: First-time full-app testing of MotoResQ. Backend: 24/24 pytest tests passed (auth, motorcycle profile, maintenance CRUD, diagnostics, guides, AI chat via Claude Sonnet 4.6, TTS audio/mpeg). Frontend: all key flows work — login screen, home tab with motorcycle card + 4 quick tiles, 6 diagnostic categories with question flow and severity results, 12 repair guides with warnings/tools/numbered steps, maintenance add + delete, AI chat with reply and Speak/TTS button. No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch) detected in the app screens tested.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~560 lines with a large in-file DIAG_TREE + REPAIR_GUIDES data block. Consider splitting content into /app/backend/data/*.json or separate module to keep server.py focused on routing.
@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI — migrate to the lifespan handler for forward compatibility.
auth signup accepts any password >= 6 chars; no email verification/rate limiting on login. Fine for MVP but worth noting.
seed_data_creation: Used existing test user rider@motoresq.app / rider1234. Test signup created TEST_<uuid>@motoresq.app users (safe to leave). Maintenance entries prefixed TEST_ or 'UI Test' created and deleted within tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend runs at EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Auth test user is rider@motoresq.app / rider1234 (already has motorcycle set). AI chat can take 5-30s. TTS returns raw audio/mpeg bytes (~4KB+). Frontend uses testID prefixes: login-*, signup-*, moto-*, qa-*, diag-*, guide-*, maint-*, chat-*. Use bottom-tab role='tab' to navigate between Home / Diagnose / Guides / More (qa-* tiles are only present on Home).
